scenes.description: A walled waystation of soot-dark stone, its one lantern burning above the gate.

lantern_hearth.description: A low hearth glows under the hanging lantern, the only warm light for miles.

chapel_road.description: A rutted road runs from the waystation's gate up a bare slope to the Hollow Chapel, a squat, blackened church whose west doors hang open on one hinge.

chapel_road: the sagging west doors into the Hollow Chapel

scenes.description: The long body of the church, open to the sky where the roof has fallen in.

nave_entrance.phrase: the west end of the nave
nave_entrance.description: Cracked flagstones and a stone holy-water stoup, gone dry, just inside the doorway.

central_aisle.description: A broad aisle running the length of the nave, littered with fallen roof slates.

collapsed_pews.description: Rows of pews crushed flat under a fallen roof beam, splinters everywhere.

apse.description: A rounded east end beneath a cracked half-dome, its plaster saints worn faceless.

connections.entrance_aisle: the open length of the nave
connections.aisle_pews: a gap between the broken pew rows
connections.aisle_apse: three worn steps up to the east end

scenes.description: A square cloister around an overgrown yard, its arcades half fallen.

cloister_walk.description: A vaulted walk along one side of the cloister, its floor worn smooth by old processions.

overgrown_garth.description: An open yard choked with brambles and dead grass, under a grey sky.

broken_arcade.description: A row of arches, several collapsed into heaps of rubble.

connections.walk_garth: a gap in the low wall onto the yard
connections.walk_arcade: the corner where the walk turns

scenes.description: A cramped sacristy, its plaster flaking, smelling of damp cloth and old wax.

vestry_door.description: A narrow stone threshold just inside the sacristy, worn hollow in the middle.

vestment_racks.description: Rows of wooden racks hung with rotting vestments that brush your face as you pass.

locked_alcove.description: A cramped alcove set into the back wall, deep in shadow.

connections.door_racks: the cramped room beyond the threshold
connections.racks_alcove: a gap at the back of the racks

scenes.description: A cold bone-house beneath the church, its walls built from the dead.

bone_stair.description: Steep stone steps, their edges set with rows of femurs.

skull_niches.description: A long chamber whose walls are honeycombed with niches, each holding a skull.

charnel_pit.description: A sunken pit heaped with loose bones, the smell thick and sweet.

warden_post.description: A cramped guard post with a stone bench and a rusted lamp hook.

connections.niches_post: an archway at the far end of the niches

scenes.description: A climbing passage toward the bell tower, cold air spilling down from above.

bell_landing.description: A small landing where a frayed bell rope hangs down the stairwell.

rope_gallery.description: A narrow wooden gallery strung with ropes and pulleys, creaking underfoot.

cracked_belfry.description: The belfry floor, split by a crack wide enough to show the drop below.

scenes.description: A treasury of relics, its cases broken and its shelves stripped.

reliquary_gate.description: A threshold behind a bent iron grille that no longer closes.

relic_shelves.description: Tall shelves of empty reliquaries and shattered glass cases.

sealed_reliquary.description: A small inner room lined with niches, its wax seals long broken.

side_chapel.description: A tiny chapel with a single cold altar and a soot-blackened ceiling.

scenes.description: The innermost sanctum, high and ember-lit, where something still keeps watch.

sanctum_threshold.description: A wide threshold before the sanctum, its floor scorched in a ring.

guardian_dais.description: A raised stone dais at the heart of the sanctum.

pillared_flank.description: A row of massive pillars along one side of the sanctum.

ember_choir.description: Choir stalls glowing with embers that never quite go out.

elements.WOODEN_PEW: A heavy wooden pew, its back carved with worn saints.
elements.STONE_PILLAR: A thick stone pillar, scarred where something has struck it.
elements.ALTAR: A plain stone altar, its cloth long rotted away.
elements.WOODEN_DOOR: An old wooden door, swollen in its frame.
elements.CHAIN: A length of heavy iron chain, bolted to the wall.
elements.CORPSE: A dead pilgrim, long past help, lying where they fell.
elements.CRATE: A wooden crate with a loose lid, the kind used to store church candles.
elements.UNSTABLE_CEILING: Cracked ceiling stones, sagging and ready to fall.
elements.FIRE: A low fire that burns without fuel.
elements.PRESSURE_PLATE: A flagstone that sits a finger's width higher than the rest.
elements.COLLAPSING_FLOOR: Floorboards gone soft and sagging over a drop.
